human_intent: Make Prometeo private state and Finance work with almost no human configuration: one owner identity, reusable device access, provider-independent Finance, secure server-side Mercado Pago integration, and Calendar consuming Finance without exposing secrets or real financial data through GitHub.
already_decided: GitHub stores code and non-sensitive coordination metadata; private runtime state and financial data stay in Supabase.
Calendar consumes the Finance abstraction / MoneyBridge, never Mercado Pago directly.
Mercado Pago is a Finance provider, not the Finance data model.
The Prometeo owner has already been claimed; do not recreate or reset owner bootstrap casually.
The initial owner bootstrap is consumed and must not be reused.
A live Finance profile already exists.
The first active device session is the mobile device used for bootstrap.
Mercado Pago remains NOT_CONNECTED until provider coverage/auth probing is explicitly performed.
No Mercado Pago credentials or real financial transaction payloads may be committed to GitHub.
PR #4 remains draft and must not be promoted merely because private runtime bootstrap succeeded.
high_value_targets: Make cross-device access require minimal human interaction without duplicating owner state.
Probe the official Mercado Pago account/report path with a tiny date range only after auth/device boundaries are stable.
Reconcile provider results against visible Mercado Pago activity before enabling automated sync.
Keep Finance provider-independent so additional banks/cards can be added later without Calendar redesign.
Eliminate copy-paste handoffs by publishing durable runtime deltas into Agent Network.
known_failures: GitHub Pages serves gh-pages; publishing bootstrap only to main caused a 404.
Supabase Auth Site URL was localhost:3000, so a successful email confirmation redirected to an unusable local address.
The first owner bootstrap expired before completion.
A SQL variable/column name collision on profile_id aborted owner+Finance+device provisioning until corrected.
Do not ask the human to repeat verification already proved by backend state.
Do not use public Git history or localStorage as storage for secrets or real financial history.

refresh_contract.same_epoch: Continue without reading NETWORK/DELTA; do not recompile context.
refresh_contract.new_epoch: Reload only this compiled packet; it already contains filtered relevant changes.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen
